name: Daloopa
description: Daloopa supplies high quality fundamental data sourced from SEC Filings, investor presentations and any public financial documents, with hyperlinks to source document overlaying each data point. Provides a zero-hallucination foundation for any quantitative financial analysis in Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Daloopa to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Daloopa to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.daloopa.com/server/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Daloopa MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Daloopa provides these MCP tools: discover_companies, discover_company_series, and get_company_fundamentals.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Daloopa?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Daloopa in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Daloopa requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Daloopa is developed by Daloopa. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
